title: Prior Authorization Is Far More Common in Medicare Advantage
headline: PRIOR AUTHORIZATION
THE VOLUME IS MUCH HIGHER
gbp_bullets: The comparison is not perfectly even
claimed_stats: FY2024: just over 625,000 traditional Medicare prior auth requests
52.8 million Medicare Advantage determinations, about 85 times as many
KFF Jan 2026: 4.1 million full or partial denials, about 7.7 percent
KFF summarizing HHS OIG June 2024: 54 percent initial denial for inpatient rehab, 65 percent for long-term care hospital, under 8 percent overall
